description: EAS schemas for the Verifiable Policy Registry. Issuer roles are separated so that the operator never certifies itself. No personal data: schools are identified only by their public Giga school ID.

schemas.name: VPR.Deployment.v1
schemas.schema: string schoolId,bytes32 scopeId,uint256 policyVersion,bytes32 resolverConfigHash,uint64 deployedAt
schemas.meaning: The operator states that the school's network resolves through a resolver configured with the given policy version. resolverConfigHash commits to the published, minimal-retention resolver configuration.

schemas.name: VPR.IndependentTest.v1
schemas.schema: string schoolId,bytes32 scopeId,uint256 policyVersion,bool categoriesBlocked,bool exceptionsReachable,bool dnssecValidated,bool bypassResisted,bytes32 reportHash,uint64 testedAt,uint64 validUntil
schemas.meaning: The independent reviewer ran black-box tests from the school network: blocked categories are blocked, exceptions are reachable (no over-blocking), DNSSEC validates, and known bypasses (external DoH/DoT, alternative DNS) fail. The summary (four booleans) is public; reportHash commits to the full report, which is shared with the governor signers rather than published because it can reveal exploitable weaknesses of a specific school network.

schemas.name: VPR.Conformance.v1
schemas.schema: bytes32 scopeId,string framework,string frameworkVersion,bytes32 reportHash,uint64 assessedAt,uint64 validUntil
schemas.meaning: An auditor records conformance of the resolver service to a named framework, e.g. framework='NIST SP 800-81r3' or 'RFC 8932 RPS' or 'UKSIC appropriate filtering'.
